question: Who among the following was the first General Secretary of All India Kisan Congress?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NG Ranga.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **NG Ranga** was the first General Secretary of **All India Kisan Congress**.
 
• **Gogineni Ranga Nayukulu,** also known as N. G. Ranga, was an Indian freedom fighter, farmers’ leader, and veteran Parliamentarian.
 
• N.G. Ranga brought peasants into our freedom struggle and fought for their cause.
 
• He was the founding president of the **Swatantra Party.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Acharya Narendra Deva**:

 
 
• He was one of the leading theorists of the **Congress Socialist Party** in India.
 
• His democratic socialism renounced violent means as a matter of principle and embraced the satyagraha as a revolutionary tactic.
 
• Dev was first drawn to nationalism around 1915 under the influence of **BG Tilak and Aurobindo Ghosh.**
 
 
 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel,** popularly known as the** Iron Man of India**.
 
 
• He was the first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of India.
 
• He was instrumental in India's independence struggle, and then for the integration of over 500 princely states into the Union of India.
 
• On the birth anniversary of Sardar Patel, on October 31, 2018, PM Modi unveiled the** 'Statue of Unity' **in Gujarat's Narmada district.
 
 
 
• **Sahajanand Saraswati **was considered a peasant leader of India.
 
 
• He along with other Hindi literary ran the **Hindi weekly Hunkar from Patna**.
 
• In 1929, He formed the Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha to mobilize peasant grievances against the zamindari attacks on their occupancy rights.
